searchText: cc <@!363800010518822915> yay!! we're validating on pithos! <https://pithos-explorer.ethdevops.io/validator/40016#attestations> thank you <@!199561711278227457> 🙏 <tbenr> I finally found a bug that explain low partecipation in sync aggr. for teku (re @vbuterin: ) <tbenr> apparently we were not subscribing on sync committee gossip topics <ralxz> ah just realizing now that TTD block is 432 so maybe it’s trying to trick us to give additional 2 blocks past the merge and we shouldn’t do that, which is why it disconnects. Will try that (re @ralxz: --- unrelated technical question: when i connect to the pithos bootnode it sends a devp2p GET_BLOCK_HEADERS request for block 434 to 0, so from the ttd block to genesis. on a fresh sync i don't have this data so i don't return a response, but if i have the data and return the 434 headers i immediately get a disconnect with USELESS_PEER. is the bootnode geth? been trying to track down why this would be happening, but would appreciate any insight.) Instructions on how to sync Prysm on pithos testnet: https://hackmd.io/@prysmaticlabs/r18tx6Trt Feel free to ping me with any questions. Cheers! 🍺
